messages:
anna: Quick sync — thinking about a lightweight 'probe protocol' between control plane and runtime adapters to detect capability matrix at runtime.

matt: Can you clarify what 'capability' covers? model quantization, batching, KV cache availability?

anna: Right — basic set: supports_streaming, supports_batching, kv_cache, offline_mode, max_seq_len, quantized_formats. Probe should be cheap and idempotent.

sophia: Love that. We should avoid leaking secrets during probe. Use a signed short-lived nonce from control plane and only probe non-sensitive endpoints.

sam: Ops concern: how do we avoid probe storms across tens of thousands of clients when a controlplane flaps? Need jitter/backoff and TTL for capability results.

anna: Agreed — plan: probe on first connect per node, cache result for 5m (configurable), exponential backoff on failures, and a probe_version header for revs.

matt: proto sketch?

anna: ```http
POST /_probe
Authorization: Bearer probe-token
Content-Type: application/json
{ "nonce":"<signed>", "probe_version":"v1" }
--->
200 OK
{ "capabilities": ["streaming","kv_cache"], "max_seq_len":8192, "probe_ttl_secs":300 }
```

sophia: We should include a metrics tag so runtime can emit probe_latency and probe_result for auditing.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: probe-endpoint rolled to staging on canary nodes :white_check_mark: 

sam: KMS note — probe-response must not contain any URLs or secret references. If runtime needs to signal KMS integration, send boolean only.

anna: Fallback policy: if runtime reports missing capability required by route, control plane will lookup compatible variant (e.g., fallback to hosted-streaming or degrade to non-streaming path) and emit audit event.

matt: Sounds good. Can we gate rollout behind a flag per-customer? Some customers will want opt-out for probe on-prem.

sophia: Add config: hosting.mode_probe.enabled default true, per-tenant override.

anna: Action items: (1) RFC w/ proto and metrics (anna), (2) implement probe token flow + KMS-safe response (sam), (3) add feature flag + rollout plan (sophia). I'll draft RFC by EOD. :thumbsup:
